editor.title: Graphical track planner
editor.speedNote: Fixed-lane values without lane changes or pit routes. Not a top-speed measurement.
editor.empty: Add pieces or import a plan.
editor.doublePit: Two parallel pit bays · shared entry/exit
editor.pitNote: Pit paths are schematic and excluded from normal lap length. Choose connections on the CU straight.
editor.importNote: TRK imports the first main sequence without deformation; other groups, levels and modern pits need review. The template contains the current double pit and existing schematic joint adjustments.
editor.importError: Import failed: invalid plan or unsupported piece.
editor.geometryNote: Original planner radii 299/497/695/893 mm; lane spacing 99 mm. Joint adjustments only close the drawing, preserve rail lengths and do not certify physical tolerances.
editor.prototypeNote: Fröhlichring template: existing model radii297/495/693/891 mm and86.25 mm quarter straight are preserved. Joint adjustments are schematic; real lane lengths may differ.
editor.entrySwitch: 1 · First entry switch: main lane → shared pit lane
editor.secondSwitch: 2 · Second entry switch after one standard straight: two parallel bays
editor.mergeBays: 3 · Merge both bays after the CU
editor.sharedExit: 4 · Shared pit exit after the CU
editor.externalError: Cannot export: pit connections require a straight sequence of345mm parts.
editor.externalNote: Softyroyal: Carrera Evolution/Digital SBP v1 with native radii and shoulders. Native positions and drawing order are retained; building heights are not included. Unknown parts are reported before import. Adapter, Check Lane and start lights export as equal-length standard straights. TRK: main course; double pit and free shoulders remain in RaceHubOS metadata. Free placement requires JSON or SBP; TRK does not support this mode.

images.error: The image could not be exported.

room.title: Room planner
room.description: Automatic proposals using Carrera Digital 132/124 catalogue rails and one CU. Set the room and driver areas first; Apply replaces only the editor draft.
room.aisleM: Clear aisle in front of drivers (m)
room.invalid: Enter valid dimensions and values within the limits.
room.noFit_people: The driver spaces and aisle do not fit. Adjust the room or reserved space.
room.noFit_space: No closed catalogue track fits the remaining area. Adjust the room or reserved space.
room.noBridge: No bridge template fits these constraints.
room.bridge: Figure eight with bridge · two levels
room.bridgeNote: Tangent adjustment up to {{joint}}°; estimated ramp reserve per side {{run}} m. Levels indicate overlap, not a completed 3D ramp.
room.note: Template planner: closed circuit and, with at least two allowed levels, a figure eight. The editor supports up to three levels; the generator uses at most two. Drivers stand in one row. Reserves 10 cm borders on each road side. People dimensions are adjustable assumptions, not standards. Check doors, furniture, access and actual ramps/supports before building. Save afterwards in the track form.
room.changed: The edited track exceeds the reserved track area. Check the room plan again.
room.referenceError: Saved tracks could not be loaded.
room.referenceNote: Basis: {{name}}. The occupied track width and depth, including borders, limit the new proposal in addition to room constraints. The source track is unchanged.
room.noFit_inventory: No template fits the selected area with this inventory. Check the CU and rail quantities, or disable the stock limit.
room.detailed: New variant · overpass and double pit

inventory.title: Owned Carrera rails
inventory.note: Supported Digital 132/124 catalogue parts. Enter individual rails; count switches as the labelled complete assemblies. Ordinary curves share stock for left/right use. Check plan-derived counts before saving.
inventory.saved: Inventory saved – available for new tracks on this RaceHubOS.
inventory.unsaved: Inventory changed; save it for future planning.
inventory.loadError: Saved inventory could not be loaded. You can still enter quantities.

parts.curved: Complete right outside → inside curve switch
parts.fuel: Pit Stop Adapter Unit / fuel rail 30361

inventory.additionalNote: Enable inventory first. Without this option only owned parts are used. When enabled, additional catalogue parts are allowed and listed separately for each proposal.
inventory.additionalDisclaimer: Quantities of individual rails or complete assemblies. Check unresolved accessories separately. Owned stock is not increased automatically.
inventory.sourceError: Saved tracks could not be loaded. The current plan remains available.
inventory.countingNote: Counts: individual rails; switches and special parts as complete catalogue assemblies. Only the selected plan is counted, not every saved variant. Check ambiguous parts manually. Native Softy imports may use the same base type for a single straight, fuel rail and single-lane adapter; check those article identities manually.
inventory.stockFirst: Available articles always appear before articles with zero stock.

search.title: New track patterns with overpass and double pit
search.description: Offline inventory search: new two-lobe crossing circuits with different corner sequences and added straights. Only the complete CU/double-pit straight is copied from the reference. The rest of the route is built anew. Unused stock remains available. Both pit bays retain their shared entry and exit. Optional S-sections add changes of turn direction.
search.noFit_source: Choose a reference with a straight CU/double-pit assembly (10–150 rails). The CU must lie between the pit entry and common exit.
search.noFit_levels: Allow at least two levels for this search.
search.noFit_clearance: The source overpass cannot be assigned without conflicts. Check its levels.
search.noFit_ramps: Not enough ramp reserve before or after the overpass for the specified height and grade.
search.noFit_search: No new variant fits this search. Increase attempts, change the variant key or adjust constraints.
search.resultNote: {{changed}} curve positions changed · max. joint adjustment {{joint}}° · {{crossings}} crossings at different levels. Pit and accessories unchanged. Check ramps and vehicle clearance before building.
search.noFit_inventory: Enable planning with your inventory. Some material for the copied CU/double-pit straight is missing. Check the stock.
search.repeat: Repeat the same search (keep variant seed)
search.diversity: Further clicks use a new seed. Similar routes are filtered out. The generator builds new circuits from catalogue sections; the bounded search does not find every possible track.
search.fewer: Fewer than three sufficiently different variants were found. Try more attempts or a new seed for further shapes.
search.newResultNote: New crossing circuit from stock · maximum joint adjustment {{joint}}° · {{crossings}} crossings on separate levels. Straight and curved ramp reserves. CU and double pit copied; see the parts list for unused stock. Check ramps and vehicle clearance before building.

dynamics.result: Corner dynamics: radii {{min}}–{{max}} mm · {{changes}} radius changes within bends · {{reversals}} direct left/right changes. {{opening}} opening / {{tightening}} tightening transitions.
dynamics.note: Geometric assessment of the main course using catalogue radii. Vehicle behaviour, grip and corner speed limits are not simulated.

graph.help: Drag rails on the canvas and rotate using the red handle. Drop catalogue parts freely. Nearby free connectors on the same level snap at similar angles. Place and replace remain available.
graph.search: Find a part: K1, K4, straight …
graph.noSelection: No rail selected · place at the course end
graph.start: Choose a part and start building here
graph.gridNote: Drag empty space to select with a box. Shift+drag starts a box over rails. Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+drag adds to the selection. Pan using the mode button or middle mouse button. Drag selected rails to move, or use the red handle to rotate the group. R / Shift+R: ±15° · Ctrl+Z: Undo. Mouse wheel over the drawing: zoom at the pointer.
graph.advanced: Pit lane, measured lengths and geometry
graph.multiple: {{count}} rails selected · Ctrl/Cmd+click: toggle; click: single selection. Shoulders and movement apply to the group. Replacement/deletion require a single selection.

print.note: Drawing fitted to the page, not 1:1 scale. Use the print dialog for paper/PDF and background colours.

free.rotate: Drag red handle to rotate · Shift: 5°
free.open: Draft: {{count}} open connectors · {{components}} separate groups · {{ambiguous}} ambiguous connectors. No continuous race circuit yet.

borders.title: Shoulders and end pieces · Carrera 124/132
borders.note: Shoulders follow their rail. Left/right follows the build direction.
borders.quantities: Individual pieces, not packs. Check the required end-piece hand; do not add an end piece at every rail joint.
borders.reserve: Planning width: 99 mm per side. End piece 20598: 138.5 × 99 mm, rounded taper based on Softyroyal planning geometry; not a dimensioned factory drawing. Room checks add a 100 mm reserve. Lane lengths unchanged.
borders.pit: This side is occupied by the double pit.
borders.conflicts: Shoulders overlap other parts on the same level (rail numbers)
borders.noRoom: The track with shoulders and planning reserve exceeds the saved available room area.
borders.special: Check CU/accessory housings, special pit shoulders and actual vehicle/bridge clearance before building. This does not certify clearance for every 124 car. Banked curves are not modelled.
borders.stock: Shoulder inventory also counts individual pieces.
borders.selection: {{count}} selected rails · caps only at free ends

work.name: Track name
work.filesNote: Your track stays local. Choose an exchange format or a complete backup.
work.importNote: RaceHubOS JSON, Autorennbahnplaner TRK or Softyroyal SBP v1. Imports are saved as a new track.
work.jsonNote: Complete design with free positions, levels, double pit and shoulders.
work.softyNote: Import native or edited Softyroyal SBP v1 files: Carrera Evolution/Digital, pit switches, single lanes and shoulders. Unknown parts are reported.
work.trkNote: Main course for Autorennbahnplaner. Experimental export; full metadata is retained only in RaceHubOS.
work.trkFree: Free rail positions cannot be exported as a native TRK sequence. Use JSON or SBP.
work.metrics: Lane lengths, lap time & room check

native.report: Softyroyal: {{items}} parts · {{crossings}} crossings · {{bays}} connected pit routes · {{unassigned}} unattached extra parts.
native.heightNote: Overpasses follow drawing order; check heights and open connections. Lane lengths cover the main course, excluding pit routes.
native.copyNote: File imports are saved as a new track.
native.unsupported: Unsupported Softyroyal parts (import cancelled without changes):

group.title: Combination
group.note: Select rails with Ctrl+click or a rectangle, then group them. Ungrouping allows individual movement; attached shoulders and pit parts follow their carrier rail. Grouping does not move parts or connect open ports.

catalogue.referenceNote: Manufacturer article index, checked 24 October 2026. Availability may change. No substitute geometry is invented for articles without verified placement data.
catalogue.geometryNote: Banked curves: nominal 2D projection, not surveyed 3D lane lengths. Check supports, vehicle suitability and physical height. Save new catalogue parts as RaceHubOS JSON; native SBP/TRK mapping unverified.

audit.chicane: Placeable complete assembly: 3 × 345 mm, 1035 mm overall length, 198 mm connector width. Internal slot curve and length are explicitly approximate.
audit.narrow: Placeable complete assembly: 4 × 345 mm, 1380 mm. Two lanes merge into one shared slot and split again. Module and connector geometry follows the original instructions and published planner data. The old 690 mm catalogue entry is contradictory.
audit.bridge: Manufacturer: four rail sections and eight supports. Elevation profile, ramp projection and 3D lane lengths are not dimensioned; do not substitute four flat straights.
audit.fixedCross: Two individually usable 345 mm rails. Each forces a lane swap; the S-slot is longer than 345 mm. Not placeable until lane mapping is verified.

catalogue.approximateSlots: Chicane: connector dimensions 1035 × 198 mm; internal slot curve and calculated slot length are planning approximations, not surveyed manufacturer data.

pitParts.combinationNote: The combination consists of the two-lane main road and separate single-lane pit parts. ESG = single-lane straight, FUEL = fuel rail.
pitParts.componentSelection: This pit component is selected separately. Select its carrier to work on the main road.

drawLayers.title: Drawing layer
drawLayers.note: Changes drawing order; positions and lane lengths remain unchanged.
